_comment: Metaobject definition for the 'Best-selling combos' section (#combos). The prototype hardcoded combo copy/prices directly in HTML; there is no native Shopify object for a curated multi-product bundle with a manual sale price, so this is modelled as a metaobject. Compare-at total and savings are NOT stored here — they're computed in Liquid from the referenced products' live prices, so they can never drift out of sync with the catalogue. Create via Shopify Admin > Content > Metaobjects (or the Admin GraphQL metaobjectDefinitionCreate mutation with this shape).
name: Combo

fieldDefinitions.name: Save badge override
fieldDefinitions.description: Leave blank to auto-compute "You save ₹X" from product prices. Use for special copy like "Biggest saving".

fieldDefinitions.name: Per-product benefit captions
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional. If provided, must have the same number of lines as Products included, in the same order.
